figure: Figure 10.5, complete radial cell-cycle illustration including the daughter-cell outcome label.
object_count_basis: Five named phases plus one text outcome, Formation of 2 daughter cells. The two phase-group labels are not counted as principal objects. Native attempts use the same six nodes plus two groups.
reading_path: Follow the circular red arrows through G₁, S, G₂, mitosis, and cytokinesis. Read the outer Interphase and Mitotic phase bands as membership/extent; cytokinesis produces two daughter cells.
merit: A nearly complete radial band makes interphase visually dominant, while a small peach mitotic sector and outer bracket separate the short division stage. Color follows phase membership, and a concise daughter-cell outcome label anchors the biological result.
